title: Rafael Uribe Uribe Palace of Culture
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap building relation 7460245 pins the outer outline and courtyard. Exact November 2006 photographs control the checker masonry, street and south entrances, cupola and inner windows. A verified 2017 view locates the surviving pale plaza-side massing.
sectionBasis: The plaza approach defines model zero in the original Terrarium field. The three street facade levels, lower storey and slate dome proportions are inferred from dated photographs. The courtyard floor is estimated independently of DEM surface heights under the building.
limitations: November 2006 exterior of the constructed palace. Open court and principal roof features are included. Facade carving, window tracery and exact historic eave and dome heights are approximate.
The 2017 CC0 overview confirms surviving massing along the plaza. Street furniture and landscaping are outside the asset.
The original DEM is retained. A viewer opening is limited to the mapped courtyard so the estimated paved floor can remain visible. Exterior thresholds and rear base grades are approximate.
